title: Character Progress Report & Partial-Result Intelligence
features: Build a consolidated Blizzard-reported Mythic+, Raids and Reputations character report with a single opt-in action.
Individual category statuses preserve successful results even if another research API is unavailable.
Copy a readable summary or export a combined JSON snapshot; cancel outstanding requests at any time.
Existing Character Intelligence, research tabs, account verification, talent planning and saved records remain untouched.
Updated the Player Handbook, Getting Started guide, developer test requests, device QA and Gateway release information.
discord_message:
NEXUS | AZEROTH COMPANION v7.9.6 — Character Progress Report

NEW: Generate one combined Blizzard-reported Mythic+, Raid and Reputation research report for a public character. Each section shows its own response status; copy the summary or export the report as JSON, with optional cancellation.

Also updated: PC/mobile Player Handbook, Getting Started, developer test checklist, Gateway details and release history.

Release is in preview pending real-player and device testing.

https://zevromxr-hub.github.io/nexus-application-gateway/azeroth-companion/

acceptance_gates: Public character report shows valid Blizzard data across available categories
One unavailable API preserves successful categories
Partial request cancellation and another run function
Combined JSON export and summary copy contain no secrets
PC/mobile navigation and saved progression remain intact
publish_rule: Keep official releases index and release file untouched while staging. Once tests pass, promote version.json to stable, add v7.9.6 to releases/index.json and create releases/v7.9.6.json as the unique Discord trigger. No automatic publication of this draft.
